I need to open the Paragraph dialog so I can define custom tab stops (one left-aligned at the start of the text and one right-aligned at the right margin). I'll use the Alt+O then P shortcut to open it.

```python
import pyautogui, time

# Open Format menu (Alt+O) and select Paragraph (P)
pyautogui.hotkey('alt', 'o'); time.sleep(0.5)
pyautogui.press('p')
```
